text: The Operations Manager needs to slice by specific regions and product lines, and she cares about fulfillment. This page is built for exploration, the opposite of the Executive Summary's glance-and-go design.

A Matrix visual, with Territory on rows, Subcategory on columns, and Total Sales as the value, so she can scan a full grid instead of reading one number at a time. A Region slicer and a Subcategory slicer, independent of the Executive Summary page's slicer. And a KPI card row: Total Sales, Total Units, and Avg Days to Ship — the fulfillment metric that has no place on the executive page.

Notice this page uses the plain Total Sales measure, with no ALL and no filter override. Every number here is supposed to respond to whichever region and subcategory are selected. That's exactly what SUM of Fact LineTotal, evaluated inside the current filter context, is built to do.
Pick one territory on this page's Region slicer, and note the Total Sales card's number. Hold onto it — you'll compare it again in the very next lesson.

With both pages now live, Total Sales here and whatever's bound to it on the Executive Summary page should agree for any matching filter selection, since they draw on the same real data. Next lesson: setting up the scheduled refresh, so this stops being something you republish by hand.
